mentions.name: Notello
mentions.description: Notello is a local-first notes and tasks app that combines both in one deeply nestable tree, with real-time multiplayer editing, offline support, and end-to-end encryption. Reads and writes hit local SQLite first with background sync, making everything instant, and it runs on web and desktop with shared core logic. It offers IDE-like navigation, a block editor, granular sharing down to individual entries, and side-by-side work and personal workspaces.
mentions.problem: The builders were tired of bouncing between a note-taking app and a task tracker: Notion is slow with limited offline capabilities, Linear is tasks-only, and Obsidian is single-player.
mentions.audience: Individuals, small teams, and powerusers who want notes and tasks combined with offline access, real-time collaboration, and control over their data
mentions.source_excerpt: Notello - local-first notes & tasks app for individuals / small teams.
